data.name: Saadoon
data.gender_notes: Saadoon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who assists and helps others, someone who supports and aids in achieving goals. The name Saadoon carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Saadoon usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Someone who is selfless and puts others needs before their own, a supporter and helper in spiritual matters
data.etymology: Saadoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saadoon total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: سعدون
in_arabic.meaning: سعدون تعني الشخص الذي يحمل السعادة والفرح
in_arabic.long_meaning: سعدون هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'سَعَدَ' والذي يعني 'سَعْد' أي الفرح والسعادة. وفقًا لعلماء اللغة العربية، فإن اسم سعدون يتضمن معاني السعادة والخير والتوفيق. وقد وردت هذه الأسماء ومشتقاتها في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، مما يعكس الأهمية الكبيرة لهذه المفاهيم في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: سعدون
in_urdu.meaning: سعدون کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو سعادت و خوشی کا مالک ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: سعدون ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر نام ہے، جو 'سَعَدَ' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'سعادت' یا 'خوشی'۔ اردو میں، اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلمانوں میں کیا جاتا ہے، جہاں یہ خوش قسمتی اور کامیابی کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق اسلامی تقالید سے ہے، جہاں 'سعد' اور 'سعادت' جیسے الفاظ کو بہت اہمیت دی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सादून
in_hindi.meaning: सादून का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो सुख और आनंद का मालिक है
in_hindi.long_meaning: सादून एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है, जो 'सअद' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'सुख' या 'आनंद'। हिंदी में, इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में किया जाता है, जहां यह सौभाग्य और सफलता के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है। इसका संबंध इस्लामी परंपरा से है, जहां 'सअद' और 'सअदत' जैसे शब्दों को बहुत महत्व दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: سعدون
in_pashto.meaning: سعدون د خوشحالۍ او برکت لرونکی سړی معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: سعدون د عربي اصل مذکر نوم دی، چې د 'سَعَدَ' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چي معنی يې 'سعادت' يا 'خوشۍ' دي. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي، چیرته چې دا د نیکمرغۍ او برکت نښه ګڼل کیږي. دا نوم د اسلامي ارزښتونو سره تړلی دی، چیرته چې 'سعد' او 'سعادت' ډیر مهم دي.

in_english.name: Saadoon
in_english.meaning: Saadoon means one who brings happiness and good fortune
in_english.long_meaning: Saadoon is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'sa'ada' which means 'to bring happiness' or 'to be happy'. The name Saadoon carries connotations of joy, prosperity, and good fortune. Etymologically, it relates to the Arabic root 's-ʿ-d' which is also found in the Quran, highlighting the significance of happiness and righteousness in Islam. Historically, names like Saadoon have been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the universal value of spreading joy and positivity.

historical_references.reference: Al-Saadoon, Ibrahim ibn Abdul-Hadi, was the fifth caliph of the Abbasid Caliphate, ruling from 809 to 822 AD.
historical_references.context: Ibrahim ibn Abdul-Hadi, also known as Al-Ma'mun, was the fifth caliph of the Abbasid Caliphate. He ruled from 809 to 822 AD and was known for his patronage of science and literature. He also initiated the widespread use of paper money in the Islamic world.

historical_references.reference: Al-Saadoon, Ali ibn Husain, was the sixth imam of the Shia sect of Islam, who was born in Medina in 658 AD and was martyred in Kufa in 680 AD.
historical_references.context: Ali ibn Husain, also known as Zainab al-Kubra, was the sixth imam of the Shia sect of Islam. He was born in Medina in 658 AD and was martyred in Kufa in 680 AD during the Battle of Karbala. He is revered as a martyr and a symbol of resistance against oppression.
